errors: First full run of experiments/m7c_stab counted held, unobservable states (unused torque estimate in integrator mode; unused attitude integrator at ki=0) as eigenvalue 1, so every design read as marginal and every ki ceiling as 0. Caught from the output, fixed in linstab.py with a regression test, re-run before any verdict was written.

doc_friction.issue: Did not apply: nothing wrong found this run; pyenv.py returned /usr/bin/python3.13 in seconds and wait_for.py --until worked for the background run.

deviations.why: Pre-registered 24 new rescaled design-conditions (12 designs x 2 multiples); the `below` designs' ki ceilings came out >= 4x or undefined, so only the 6 `above` designs could be rescaled.
deviations.did: Ran 12 new design-conditions and said so in LOG and README.
deviations.result: U5 judged on the 12 that exist.

notes: Research draw: programme codesign-cant, milestone 7c (linear stability of attitude+position loop with side-force feed-forward). linstab.py 11-state map matches poshold.rollout to 1e-3. Results: necessary-not-sufficient test (0/2688 stable flights diverged; accuracy 0.902 vs 0.95 predicted); retrained designs sit at 0.88-1.11x the linear ki/kp ceiling; 0.8x ceiling designs never diverge; m7 cmd-ff per-episode accuracy 0.995. Local checks: codesign-cant pytest, research build ok, research_live_links, check_md_links, cite_check, post checks.
